verdict.rationale: Omnara documents an API, TypeScript SDK and CLI, plus subagent spawning and task queuing. None of the evidence describes a bulk-operation capability that acts on many items (agents, conversations, configs) at once. The API and SDK are developer building blocks a user could script against, and subagents and queuing are adjacent features, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
